description: Minimal polynomial over Q (primitive integer coefficients, positive leading coefficient, listed from the constant term up) of every vertex coordinate of sphere_228; 'real_root' is the coordinate's value (30 decimals) in the real embedding w1,w2,w3 > 0, i.e. the root of the polynomial nearest to that decimal (see distance_to_nearest_other_root).
method: char. polynomial N_{F3/Q}(x - alpha) computed exactly down the tower (product over the 8 sign flips of w1, w2, w3), factored with python-flint; the unique irreducible factor is the minimal polynomial.
